{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for LOYAL customers, completed orders, and exclude QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
loyal_completed_clean = df[
    (df['customer_segment'].str.lower() == 'loyal') &
    (df['status'] == 'completed') &
    (df['revenue'] != 999999.99)
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed_clean['revenue'].mean()

print(f'Rows in loyal_completed_clean: {len(loyal_completed_clean)}')
print(f'Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}')"}
